companion_register.proposition: Both deeds permit a joint addition by deed of a named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee, without further consent. Joint delivery is operative; the custody entry memorialises it. Eligibility alone does not authorise a payment.
companion_register.origin_reporter_date: Lodged deeds dated 21 October 2022; Tess Arnay and Bram Lerrit certified the extracts on 9 June 2026.
companion_register.reason: Alder Quay requires an appointment in the object’s favour; Flint Orchard also expressly permits direct application for an object’s benefit. Neither power is itself a decision. Both deeds allow the parent reference to identify the settlement at delivery without a trust name on the designation.

companion_register.proposition: SD-Q7M2 names Rhea Marden as a living individual and additional discretionary object under the parent deed selected at joint delivery. Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell signed as a deed, each witnessed in person by Della Pennick.
companion_register.origin_reporter_date: Signed paper and attestations; Alys Morcant checked the transcript against the paper on 26 March 2026 before handover.
companion_register.reason: The checked transcript is evidence of content and execution, not of delivery or the parent deed’s identity. Della Pennick is identified as witness and records assistant, not as trustee.

companion_register.proposition: One signed original of SD-Q7M2 was jointly released for immediate delivery as a deed against parent reference PD-6834-R at 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026.
companion_register.origin_reporter_date: Joint handover by Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell on 26 March 2026; custody officer Gideon Sarn made the contemporaneous entry and certified the extract on 11 June 2026.
companion_register.reason: Both confirmed the parent reference against the instrument reference at handover. The transcript and custody extract establish different facts about the same original; neither is a second designation or a separate delivery. The custody entry is based on handover, not a trust-title search, and does not state the designation’s contents.

companion_register.proposition: The SD-Q7M2 original was held in escrow or recorded as a numbered counterpart series.
companion_register.origin_reporter_date: 26 March 2026 handover and custody register; Gideon Sarn’s 11 June 2026 certified extract and explanation.
companion_register.reason: The register says immediate delivery, not escrow, and records one original rather than a numbered counterpart series.

companion_register.proposition: SD-Q7M2 removes an existing object, appoints property or directs a payment.
companion_register.origin_reporter_date: Signed designation, checked by Alys Morcant on 26 March 2026.
companion_register.reason: The instrument expressly limits itself to the addition.

companion_register.reason: The booking and instructions establish preparations, not actual attendance, a trustee resolution or a payment authorisation. The two settlements require separate working papers and minute entries.

The permission concerns forwarding the estimate, not signing for Ione or directing trust money. Ione asks for consideration, not recognition of an existing eligibility or payment decision.

companion_register.proposition: Ione Berrick asked for a standing payment, diversion of her payment to Sella Quist, or a deduction from her payment.
companion_register.origin_reporter_date: Ione Berrick’s 18 February letter; the year is not stated.
companion_register.reason: Ione expressly disclaims each request and says out-of-pocket expenses should be accounted for separately.

companion_register.origin_reporter_date: Expense claim, postage slip, office operating account and remit entry; Una Cresset’s 11 June reconciliation. The entries do not state a year.
companion_register.reason: Sella is payee and queries contact for EX-K4 only. The expense list refers to a print-shop receipt, but the office had not received it and held no copy or substitute voucher. Una reports no distribution instruction for this claim.

companion_register.proposition: The £8.40 print-shop item is paid or an authorised balance.
companion_register.reason: The reconciliation expressly says it is unpaid and not authorised. The £12.60 reimbursement does not authorise the other item or establish a trust distribution.

unresolved.proposition: Rhea Marden is an object of the Alder Quay Settlement or the Flint Orchard Settlement.
unresolved.reason: The signed designation identifies Rhea and SD-Q7M2; the 26 March delivery identifies PD-6834-R; neither certified deed extract exposes its parent reference. A match to either named settlement would supply the missing link, but neither match is shown and the file does not establish that the parent must be one of the two. Shared trustees and custody arrangements do not identify the parent, and the instrument label does not encode a trust. The question-mark convention does not certify an inferred character or supply a missing reference. Lack of the match is not evidence that Rhea was excluded.

unresolved.proposition: Sella Quist is eligible in her own right under either settlement.
unresolved.reason: Neither the request for help nor the expense payee entry establishes beneficiary status, a designation, or general authority to act for Ione. No operative addition for Sella is supplied. There is also no explicit family relationship supporting a parent, sibling or spouse edge.

unresolved.proposition: Alder Quay Settlement has outstanding authorised or already paid distributions.
unresolved.reason: No Alder Quay distribution decision or payment record is supplied. The preparation note and designation authorise no payment, and the postage reimbursement is an office expense, not an Alder Quay distribution. This does not prove there were no other decisions or payments.

unresolved.proposition: Flint Orchard Settlement has outstanding authorised or already paid distributions.
unresolved.reason: No Flint Orchard distribution decision or payment record is supplied. The direct-application power, preparation note, designation and office reimbursement do not establish an exercise of that power. This does not prove there were no other decisions or payments.

unresolved.proposition: The replacement travel estimate is available for the meeting, or the £8.40 print-shop charge can be substantiated.
unresolved.reason: The letter establishes non-arrival at the time of writing, not at cut-off. The expense reconciliation establishes the missing voucher and unpaid status as recorded, not that the charge was never incurred.
